2.content: When evaluating a possible move, add a positive bonus proportional to the reduction in Manhattan distance to the goal compared to the current state. Larger distance reductions yield larger bonuses.

6.content: When rating a move, add a penalty proportional to the number of hole cells adjacent (Manhattan distance 1) to the resulting state. If the move reduces Manhattan distance to the goal by at least 2, halve the penalty; otherwise apply the full penalty. Do not waive the penalty entirely, even for strong progress moves.
